change_note: November 9 review of all 50 companies. Deployed compute, enterprise controls and scarce power infrastructure strengthen selected scores; external cloud dependence tempers frontier-lab Energy forecasts. Same cohort and locked methodology. September is preserved; no October edition is backfilled. The 2026 assessment advances to November 9; 2027 and 2030 forecast target dates remain September 18.

rows.research_premise: Alphabet reports Q3 Google Cloud revenue of $30.7 billion, up 103%, with TPU systems sales contributing. Search revenue grew 12%.
rows.thesis: Compute rises to 100: deployed cloud scale and external TPU commercialization strengthen the infrastructure bottleneck. Interface was already at 100. Future OCI TPU deployments do not add current Energy credit.
rows.reconsider_if: Agents displace Google’s discovery surfaces faster than Gemini captures the new interaction.

rows.research_premise: Microsoft reports Azure revenue of $33.2 billion, up 48%, and Microsoft Cloud growth of 30% in the September quarter.
rows.thesis: Compute rises to 95 as operating Azure capacity and adoption substantiate more of the platform position. Existing enterprise Interface and Alignment judgments hold; revenue growth alone does not establish greater electricity control.
rows.reconsider_if: Customers move their agent orchestration and identities outside Microsoft’s products.
rows.change_note: 2026 Compute 90 → 95.

rows.research_premise: Amazon reports AWS Q3 revenue of $46.0 billion, up 39%, and operating income of $17.8 billion.
rows.thesis: All inputs hold. Strong operating evidence reinforces the already high Compute score; faster revenue growth is not a separate force or an automatic upgrade.
rows.reconsider_if: Custom-chip commitments fail to convert into useful capacity or customers bypass AWS’s agent layer.
rows.change_note: All 12 force inputs retained after review; rank may move as peers change.

rows.research_premise: NVIDIA announced an independent board inquiry following reporting concerning its CEO. The board stated it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets had been compromised and retained confidence in leadership.
rows.thesis: All inputs hold. The inquiry is an unresolved risk, not a finding of lost Compute control. Alignment measures authority over AI actions, not executive reputation. Reassess if findings change export access, operating leadership, or enforceable controls.
rows.reconsider_if: The board inquiry produces verified findings that impair export access, operational continuity, or enforceable controls; or alternative compute stacks erode customer dependence faster than forecast.
rows.change_note: All 12 force inputs retained after review; rank may move as peers change.

rows.research_premise: Meta reports 3.64 billion daily active people, launches of Muse and Muse Wonder, and $34.91 billion of quarterly capital expenditure. Its $135–145 billion annual capex range is guidance.
rows.thesis: All inputs hold. Distribution remains a major strength; model launches and planned spending do not by themselves demonstrate a new five-point step in control.
rows.reconsider_if: Meta turns messaging into the dominant environment for commercial agent transactions.
rows.change_note: All 12 force inputs retained after review; rank may move as peers change.

rows.research_premise: OpenAI reports more than 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users and availability of ChatGPT Enterprise through AWS Marketplace. Its October Google Cloud announcement plans model availability in coming weeks.
rows.thesis: Current Interface rises to 100 for direct reach and procurement distribution. We temper forecast infrastructure sovereignty: cloud purchasing and partnerships provide access, not ownership of suppliers or their electricity. This revises the September forecast, not observed capacity.
rows.reconsider_if: Direct user and enterprise adoption stalls, or external compute and firm-power delivery fails to convert contracted access into reliable capacity. Verified control of more energized infrastructure would support higher forecasts.
